serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: This movie was awesome!
You: I’m glad you liked it.
Bot: Such a good animal. Those owners didn’t deserve it!
Bot: There’s one thing I didn’t get. What was so controversial about this movie? I didn’t notice anything out of the ordinary. Internet people said something about the dog not being right, but it seemed alright to me. A faithful depiction of loyalty and intelligence.
You: Well… {{wi}}Some people probably didn’t like the fact that this time Lassie was a pitbull and not a border collie…
Bot: What difference does that make?
You: No comment.
